quote_zh: 6. A process for preparing a 3-bromomethylbenzoic acid of formula II which comprises brominating a 3-methylbenzoic acid of formula I with N-bromosuccimide in the presence of a radical initiator, where, in formulae I and II R1 is fluorine, chlorine or bromine, and R2 is (C1-C4)alkyl. 11. The process as claimed in claim 6, wherein the brominating is carried out at a temperature of from 70 to 100° C. 12. The process as claimed in claim 10, wherein the brominating reaction is carried out at the reflux temperature of the solvent.
arithmetic_check: Nothing to check. This is a process claim set: it states no charge, no mass, no volume, no molar ratio, no reaction time and no yield, so there is no arithmetic to close and no mass balance or molar-mass check can be computed. The only quantities printed anywhere in the section are the temperature bounds 70 and 100 degrees C and the claim numbers themselves.
drawing_evidence: Nothing. Every IMAGE_EXTRACT span in this section is a single Markush structure of formula I or formula II with variable R1 and R2, and each carries {"molecules": []} because the vision pass refused a SMILES for a generic. There is no drawn reaction scheme in this patent, so the spans corroborate no step boundary, contribute no reagent and support no connectivity, and none of the drawing-related validation flags can arise. Claim 6 itself has no span beside it at all; the two spans in this part of the section stand at L177 and L179, after claim 13, and a third at L193 belongs to compound claim 19.
